method: Every string is checked mechanically; a sample of 160 strings per language is read for meaning, register and consistency (a wrong meaning counts 1, an awkward or inconsistent wording 0.5); the rate is carried over to the whole catalogue, reduced by the haircut (what the checker cannot see in that language) and by the terms the interface renders differently from the nomenclature. A string that changed later is read one by one.

findings.translation: ਦਸਤਖ਼ਤ ਗੁਪਤ ਹੁਣੇ ਕਾਪੀ ਕਰੋ - ਇਹ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇੱਕ ਵਾਰ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ:

findings.english: Verify
findings.translation: ਪੜਤਾਲੋ
findings.note: 'ਪੜਤਾਲੋ' is an informal imperative; the rest uses 'ਕਰੋ'

findings.english: Deprecations
findings.translation: ਬੰਦ ਕਰਨ ਦੀਆਂ ਕਾਰਵਾਈਆਂ
findings.note: 'ਬੰਦ ਕਰਨ ਦੀਆਂ ਕਾਰਵਾਈਆਂ' means closing actions

findings.english: Reference number in the separate escalation code pool — not a CSCM Tool status code.
findings.translation: ਵੱਖਰੇ ਵਾਧਾ ਕੋਡ ਪੂਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਨੰਬਰ — CSCM Tool ਦਾ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਕੋਡ ਨਹੀਂ।

findings.english: User deleted; its name and address are erased, what it did stays attributable.
findings.translation: ਵਰਤੋਂਕਾਰ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ; ਉਸਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਪਤਾ ਮਿਟਾ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਗਏ, ਜੋ ਉਸਨੇ ਕੀਤਾ ਉਹ ਪਛਾਣਯੋਗ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

findings.english: Saving again keeps your entries and replaces the stored values.
findings.translation: ਮੁੜ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਐਂਟਰੀਆਂ ਰਹਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਟੋਰ ਮੁੱਲ ਬਦਲ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।

findings.translation: მოძველებები

findings.translation: ყველა სტრიქონი სუფთაა.

findings.english: User deleted; its name and address are erased, what it did stays attributable.
findings.translation: მომხმარებელი წაიშალა; მისი სახელი და მისამართი წაშლილია, მისი ქმედებები კვლავ მიეკუთვნება.

findings.translation: გამოშვებული კოდები ჯერ არ არის.

findings.english: Select the Approved, non-sandbox revisions to include, then Save. Publishing is immutable — a correction requires a new Release.
findings.translation: აირჩიეთ დამტკიცებული, არასანდბოქს რევიზიები ჩასართავად, შემდეგ შეინახეთ. გამოქვეყნება შეუქცევადია — შესწორებას ახალი რელიზი სჭირდება.

findings.english: fixed: it identifies you, also for the Windows sign-in
findings.translation: ფიქსირებულია: ის გაიდენტიფიცირებთ, Windows-ით შესვლისთვისაც

findings.english: A profile fixes the columns, their order and header labels, and optionally a default audience and language. Profiles are data: change them here, no deployment needed.
findings.translation: ପ୍ରୋଫାଇଲ୍ ସ୍ତମ୍ଭ, ସେମାନଙ୍କ କ୍ରମ ଓ ଶୀର୍ଷକ ଲେବଲ୍ ଏବଂ ବିକଳ୍ପ ଭାବେ ଡିଫଲ୍ଟ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ଓ ଭାଷା ସ୍ଥିର କରେ। ପ୍ରୋଫାଇଲ୍ ଡାଟା: ଏଠାରେ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ, ମୁତୟନ ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।
findings.note: 'ମୁତୟନ' is not a word for deployment

findings.english: Reference number in the separate escalation code pool — not a CSCM Tool status code.
findings.translation: ପୃଥକ ଉତ୍କଟତା କୋଡ୍ ପୁଲ୍‌ରେ ସନ୍ଦର୍ଭ ସଂଖ୍ୟା — CSCM Tool ସ୍ଥିତି କୋଡ୍ ନୁହେଁ।

findings.english: Copy the signing secret now - it is shown only once:
findings.translation: ସାଇନିଂ ଗୁପ୍ତ ଏବେ କପି କରନ୍ତୁ - ଏହା କେବଳ ଥରେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ:

findings.english: User deleted; its name and address are erased, what it did stays attributable.
findings.translation: ଉପଯୋଗକର୍ତ୍ତା ଲିଭାଯାଇଛି; ତାଙ୍କ ନାମ ଓ ଠିକଣା ମାଡ଼ି ଦିଆଯାଇଛି, ସେ ଯାହା କରିଛନ୍ତି ତାହା ଚିହ୍ନଟଯୋଗ୍ୟ ରହେ।
findings.note: 'ମାଡ଼ି ଦିଆଯାଇଛି' means pressed down, not erased

findings.english: No Released codes yet.
findings.translation: ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ମୁକ୍ତ କୋଡ୍ ନାହିଁ।

findings.english: The current set of every Released status code, independent of any single Release.
findings.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ରିଲିଜ୍‌ରୁ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ଭାବେ, ମୁକ୍ତ ହୋଇଥିବା ସମସ୍ତ ସ୍ଥିତି କୋଡ୍‌ର ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ସମୂହ।
